语音转文字 - 使用OpenAI Whisper将音频文件识别为文字

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of whisper-stt skill:

- Converts audio/voice files to text using OpenAI Whisper.
- Automatically processes audio files sent by users and sends recognized text to Feishu.
- Supports a wide range of audio formats, including MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG, FLAC, and WebM.
- Offers multiple Whisper models for flexible trade-offs between speed, size, and accuracy.
- Requires Python 3.8+, PyTorch, openai-whisper, and ffmpeg.
